## Landed — Gerrit change 2448 MERGED to origin/main (Verified +1 AND LLM-Review +1)

Concrete external artifacts for the final acceptance criterion (the Gerrit merge lives outside the repo snapshot, so the criterion is tagged `[non-codebase]` and evidenced here):

**Gerrit change 2448** (https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/2448) — status **MERGED**, submitted 2026-08-31 00:26:33Z (plain Submit; main is Rebase-If-Necessary).
- **Verified +1 (SUCCESS)** on patchset 2 — CI run https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/actions/runs/33343259378. All tiers green: `lint + type-check` ✓ (14m28s), `pytest ubuntu py3.11` ✓, `py3.12` ✓, `py3.13` ✓, `pytest macos py3.13` ✓ — **18368 unit + 169 integration passed** (77+11 skipped), diff-coverage 100% on changed lines, total coverage 86.44%, module-size gate ✓, complexity ratchet ✓. (Patchset 1's earlier `Verified -1` was a cancellation artifact — pushing PS2 superseded the in-flight PS1 run via GitHub Actions cancel-in-progress; every PS1 step had actually succeeded. Not a test failure, so no `recheck`.)
- **LLM-Review +1 (PASS)** on patchset 2 — 1 non-blocking advisory (the deterministic "contrast control" assertion documenting the lockstep baseline my jitter is measured against; intentional, did not block the PASS).
- 0 unresolved comments.

**Merged to origin/main** as commit `5c28ce66bbfd8867a5cb50c4d2daffd585f1fffe` (Gerrit rebased the patchset on submit), carrying `rebar-ticket: 254e-1770-854b-47a2`. origin/main and gerrit main both at that SHA.

`make lint && make typecheck && make test` were attested green in the Phase 2 comment (ruff + format + complexity ratchet new=0/increased=0; mypy 716 files; 236 llm/transport-adjacent tests) and independently re-verified by the CI Verified lane above across four OS/Python tiers. All four acceptance criteria are met; proceeding to close as `preexisting` with `caused_by=morbid-uncultured-arcticduck`.
